# Ornithe Standard Libraries 0.22.2

OSL 0.22.2 supports Minecraft versions between Alpha 1.0.1_01 and Release 1.14.4.

## Block States 0.1.1

Fixed module for 15w47a-1.9.3-pre1 not loading, which prevented the Blocks and Items APIs to load for these versions as well.

## Localization 0.1.3

Fixed server-side translations in 1.1-1.5.

## Items 0.3.1

Fixed `ClassNotFoundException` in b1.9-pre3.

# Ornithe Standard Libraries 0.22.1

OSL 0.22.1 supports Minecraft versions between Alpha 1.0.1_01 and Release 1.14.4.

## Changes

OSL now bundles [Conditional Mixin](https://github.com/OrnitheMC/conditional-mixin/) 1.0.0.

## Entities 0.1.1

Fixes a crash in Alpha 1.1.x.
- note: to fix the crash, a Vanilla multiplayer bug was fixed where all sheep and cows appear as chickens on the client.

releases.notes:
## Ornithe Standard Libraries 0.21.1

OSL 0.21.1 supports Minecraft versions between Alpha 1.0.1_01 and Release 1.14.4.

## Networking 0.10.1

### Fixes

- Fixed memory leaks.
- Fixed crash when disconnected from the server before login.

## Resource Loader 0.8.1

### Fixes

- Improve logging of errors when reading `pack.mcmeta`.
- Fixes NPEs and crashes when resource pack summary cannot be parsed.

## Text Components 0.1 Alpha 6

The JSON format of OSL text components now supports hex color notation using a `#` prefix.
